title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Hard Rock Live, Hollywood | 2010
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at Hard Rock Live, situated at the Seminole Hard Rock Hollywood in Hollywood, Florida, USA, on 15 July 2010.

It was the 16th show of the 11th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 31 dates between June and August 2010.

Starr previously performed at the Hard Rock Live on 3 July 2008. He returned there on 30 June 2012, 17 September 2022, and 20 June 2025. Paul McCartney also performed at the venue on 25 May 2022.

The 11th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Wally Palmar: vocals, guitar, harmonica
  • Rick Derringer: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Gary Wright: vocals, keyboards
  • Richard Page: vocals, bass guitar
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums
